Button plate + RimThemes check

New direction, not locked in: ancient ship-helm console, not desert scavenger rust — aged grey machined metal, thin glowing vector-line schematics, amber & cyan readouts. First concept render below, built from the reference photos and screens you sent.

Direction: the helm, not the scrapyard

Built from your reference photos (Galaxy's Edge panels, the adobe-embedded switch panel, the amber Aurebesh tactical display, the grey console bank with cyan nav-plots, the cockpit fuel readout, and the R2 blueprint sheet — all now in design/Jawa/worldbuilding/ui_references/) plus Zero Company's own in-game UI chrome for how a modern screen reads. Aged, worn, centuries-old and lovingly kept running — not junk-built.

First concept render
Not a shippable 9-slice asset yet — a mood/direction concept to react to. Grey-green gunmetal (no rust, no brown), thin white vector schematic lines linking every cluster, amber glow on the active elements, a central tactical nav-plot with small glyph labels. If this reads right, the next step is tracing it into a proper tileable button atlas + panel set.
Fonts — something Aurebesh-flavored but legible

Swapped the display type on this page to Orbitron (kept Rajdhani for sub-labels) — blocky, geometric, angular strokes reminiscent of Aurebesh's letterforms without actually substituting the alphabet, so it stays readable. Compare against the headline above and the button labels below. If you want it pushed further (more angular, more "glyph-like"), say so and I'll try alternates.

About these three button-plate options below

These three (Heavy / Clean / Chalk) all predate the pivot above — they're the old "desert rust plate" direction. Keeping them here for reference, but given the new "ancient ship helm" direction, none of the three is really a live contender any more unless you want to keep that plate style specifically for buttons while the rest of the UI goes helm-console. Worth saying which way you're leaning.

RimThemes live check

Ran a real in-game check on a clean, interference-free 23-mod list (just RimThemes + this theme, nothing else that could conflict).

Confirmed working
Main menu: theme selection persists across restarts (even a full mod-list swap), main menu buttons render our atlas, and the RimThemes indicator shows our icon as active.

Real gap, not ours
Neither shows a themed panel texture — just a plain grey square with a tinted border. Confirmed it's not another mod interfering (this list has nothing else UI-related) and not our art (RimThemes' own first-party Cyberpunk theme does the identical thing). This looks like a RimThemes limitation that affects every theme equally — nothing to fix on our side. Same story on the float-menu popup below.
